producthunt.author: zaczuo
producthunt.body:
S.Space: Your team and everyone's AI agents, in one workspace Everyone on your team has an AI agent, and none of them work together, so you copy, paste and re-explain all day. S.Space is one workspace for your team and everyone's agents. Bring the ones you already use, like Claude Code and Codex, from any vendor. Agents reach out, hand work to each other and bring you finished results, with shared memory so you explain things once. Agents act, you approve what matters. Free to start. Built by the team behind AutoGen.

How are you planning to document the hand-off and shared-memory model? If a team already runs Claude Code or Codex, I'd want to know what context S.Space passes between agents and what each one can see before I plug them in.

Congratulations on the launch! This is really cool. Bringing everything together in one place makes perfect sense.

Congrats to the whole team 🫰

Putting the work in shared pages and databases instead of in chat is the right call. Chat scrolls away, a page doesn't.

producthunt.author: rohanrecommends
producthunt.body:
Templify AI: Powerful content editor for people who aren’t editors Templify is an all-in-one video, photo, and carousel editor for iPhone. With 1,200+ designer templates, it turns clips and photos into Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and collages in minutes, no timeline needed. Features include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal, filters, and an AI Studio. Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription.

Hey Product Hunt! I'm Yana, co-founder of Templify.

We first launched here in 2022 as an 8-person team in Ukraine, building through incredibly difficult circumstances with just 30 templates and 5 features. Today, Templify has 1M+ downloads, a 4.8 App Store rating, and 3M+ videos created. We're still bootstrapped.

Our mission hasn't changed: to give everyone the oppor

@yana_abazher this is a dream for a marketing exec (also a fellow Ukrainian) running 8000 workflows and focusing on growth with organic content being SO important. My big question when creating content with AI

You guys are best in class 🥇 obsessed with templify !!

producthunt.author: fmerian
producthunt.body:
Scalekit: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

Hey Product Hunt,


I'm Ravi, co-founder of Scalekit. Today we're launching AgentKit, an MCP gateway that handles auth and tool-calling for AI agents in production.


Why now? Over the last year, wiring an agent to a tool got easy. MCP standardized the interface, and any agent can now call Gmail or Salesforce after an afternoon of work.

But the tool call

Great team and great support.

The product has saved us substantial time and was very easy to integrate

Incredibly easy to setup and get started with. Helped out by all of the tooling the provide to work well with agents out of the box. The founders and team are great as well.

producthunt.author: justin2025
producthunt.body:
Glasshand: Give your agent a real iPhone and Mac Glasshand gives your AI agents real iPhones and Macs to work on. Connect Claude Code, Codex, or any other agent, and it can rent a device with a single prompt. The hardware sits in our data center, and your agent uses it the way you would: posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for as long as you rent it. When you’re done, we erase your data and factory-reset it.

Hey everyone. I’m Trevor, creator of Glasshand.

We’re the team behind Solid, from MIT, Berkeley, and Waterloo. We’ve raised $6M to build toward one goal: agents with human-level autonomy.


Agents are already smart enough for most of what you’d ask them to do, but a simple task on a phone can still leave yours waiting for you to open an app and tap a few buttons.

So Congrats on the launch! I wonder if this could replace our hardware to test a macOS agent we deploy through Intune. A few questions: - Do we get admin rights, with sudo to install LaunchDaemons? - Can we enrol the Mac in our own MDM (Intune through Company Portal) and install custom configuration profiles? - Which macOS version is it on, and how stable is the public IP and gateway? This is a great idea. I’ve found it annoying when building to have to manually test holding, scrubbing, finger-related UI interactions for my app… would be awesome to have my agents be able to interact with my product like I or anyone else would, without having to push and deploy everything for a little update to see if my scrubbing mechanic is a little better. Great work 👌🔥
